question: Foods containing fats and carbohydrates are also called ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**energy giving foods**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Foods containing fats and carbohydrates are classified as **energy giving foods** because they provide the body with energy needed for daily activities.
 
• Carbohydrates are the **primary source of energy**, easily broken down into glucose, which fuels the body’s cells.
 
• Fats serve as a **concentrated energy reserve**, providing more than double the energy per gram compared to carbohydrates or proteins.
 
• Examples of energy giving foods include **bread, rice, potatoes (carbohydrates)**, and butter, nuts, and oils (fats).
 
• These foods are essential for maintaining the body’s metabolic functions, especially during physical exertion or intense activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carbohydrates:**

 
 
• Classified as simple (e.g., glucose, fructose) or complex (e.g., starch, fiber).
 
• Provide 4 calories per gram and are the body’s preferred energy source.
 
• Excess carbohydrates are stored as glycogen in the liver and muscles or converted to fat.
 
 
 
• **Fats:**
 
 
• Provide 9 calories per gram, making them the most calorie-dense nutrient.
 
• Include saturated fats (e.g., butter, lard) and unsaturated fats (e.g., olive oil, fish oil).
 
• Essential for absorption of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, and K).
 
 
 
• **Energy Balance:**
 
 
• Maintaining energy balance is crucial for weight management and overall health.
 
• Excess energy intake leads to weight gain, while insufficient intake causes weight loss.
 
 
 
• **Other Energy Sources:**
 
 
• Proteins can also be used for energy, but primarily serve as building blocks for growth and repair.
 
• In cases of prolonged starvation, the body uses fats and proteins for energy.
